text: I think you'll really enjoy the Easy Cheese-Tomato Melt recipe. As a vegetarian looking to boost your protein intake, this dish delivers with 22 grams of protein per serving. The combination of shredded mozzarella cheese and fresh tomatoes on whole wheat bread provides a satisfying and filling snack that should keep you within your 15-minute time budget. Plus, the ingredients are straightforward and easy to find, making it a great option for a quick and easy meal.
